title: The Powerhouse Design System provides reusable UI components based on GraphQL scalars including web3 types
content:
The Powerhouse Design System is a collection of reusable front-end components based on GraphQL scalars. It provides:

- Consistent UI components across Powerhouse applications
- Automatic inclusion as a dependency in new projects
- Customization via CSS variables
- Custom scalar types tailored for the web3 ecosystem

Built-in GraphQL scalars: `String`, `Int`, `Float`, `Boolean`, `ID`
Powerhouse custom scalars: `OID` (Object ID), `Currency`, `DateTime`, and other web3-specific types

These scalars are more than just type definitions - they are linked to reusable front-end components from the `@powerhousedao/document-engineering` package. When you use a custom scalar in your schema, corresponding UI components are available for rendering and editing that data type.

## Precision on naming and location

"Design System" is loose here: `@powerhousedao/design-system` and `@powerhousedao/document-engineering` are **two different packages** — the former lives in the powerhouse monorepo (`packages/design-system`), the latter is an independently versioned external repo. The scalar-backed components described above come from document-engineering.

The scalar definitions live in `src/scalars/graphql/` of that repo, one file per scalar. `OID.ts`, `Currency.ts` and `DateTime.ts` are all present, alongside `Amount`, `AmountCrypto`, `AmountCurrency`, `AmountFiat`, `AmountMoney`, `AmountPercentage`, `AmountTokens`, `Date`, `EmailAddress`, `EthereumAddress`, `OLabel`, `PHID`, `URL` and `File`. Their UI counterparts split across three subpaths: `/scalars` (form fields), `/ui` (layout) and `/table`.

_Source-verified 2026-08-13 against the document-engineering repo at v1.40.5 (`/home/p/Powerhouse/document-engineering`), a separate repo from the powerhouse monorepo._
description: Custom scalars like OID, Currency, and DateTime are linked to reusable front-end components in the design system.
